title: Unable to connect to Nightscout -No error in log
symptom: Unable to connect APS to self-hosted Nightscout server. It worked on a previous phone with a previous version of APS. Browser and xdrip+ can access/upload to Nightscout. Log shows only 'NSCLIENT destroy' and 'NSCLIENT do connect' lines, and UI state never changes from connecting.
cause: The thread does not explicitly state a root cause, but the maintainer's response 'then read release notes pls' implies that the issue is due to a version incompatibility between AndroidAPS 3.2.0.4 and Nightscout 14.2.6, likely requiring a newer Nightscout version.
fix: The thread does not provide a specific fix; the maintainer suggests reading release notes, implying an upgrade of Nightscout is needed.
